cards.title: Bank API Gateway Approval & Production Sandbox Keys
cards.description:
Awaiting production OAuth credentials and sandbox webhook activation from partner bank. Required before end-to-end payment testing can proceed.

### Blocker Impact:
- **Blocks**: End-to-End Payment Testing with 3D Secure
- **Owner**: Sarah K. (Backend Lead)
- **Status**: Escalated with bank account rep on Nov 12. Follow-up meeting scheduled 3:00 PM.

cards.title: End-to-End Payment Testing with 3D Secure Matrix
cards.description:
Run full validation matrix of Visa Secure, Mastercard Identity Check, and AmEx SafeKey flows across mobile Safari, Android Chrome, and desktop browsers.

### Dependency:
- **Blocked by**: Bank API Gateway Approval & Production Sandbox Keys
- **Target completion**: 24h after credentials cleared.

cards.title: Guest Checkout Flow & Address Autocomplete
cards.description:
Allow first-time buyers to complete purchase without mandatory registration. Integrates Google Places autocomplete to minimize mobile address typos.

### Key Metrics:
- Reduces checkout friction from 4 screens to 2
- Expected conversion lift: +12%

decision.title: Keep Guest Checkout in v2.4 Release Scope
decision.rationale: Telemetry revealed an 18% cart abandonment rate at the mandatory registration wall. Postponing guest checkout would severely risk initial launch GMV.

cards.title: Mobile Checkout Funnel Telemetry & Viewport Polish
cards.description: Audit sticky payment CTA button behavior on compact 375px viewports (iPhone SE / mini). Ensure virtual keyboard appearance does not obscure total summary.

cards.title: Production Zero-Downtime Deployment Runbook
cards.description: Finalize step-by-step rollout protocol, database migration safety scripts, and instant feature flag rollback criteria for Friday release.

cards.title: Stripe Elements Migration & Apple Pay Integration
cards.description: Migrated legacy form inputs to unified payment element with native Apple Pay and Google Pay one-click tokenization.

cards.title: Responsive Cart Drawer & Tax Estimation Layout
cards.description: Designed sliding slide-over cart drawer with instant promo code validation, shipping rate calculation, and cart item quantity steppers.

cards.title: Idempotent Refund & Dispute Webhook Handlers
cards.description: Engineered cryptographic signature verification and idempotent processing for charge.refunded and dispute.created webhooks.
